title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-fused-kv-continuous-batching
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR upgrades the attention kernel stack in the serving runtime to FlashAttentionV2 and introduces a set of fused operators and rotary/rope compatibility fixes. Motivation: primary production workloads show 25-40% per-token GPU time reductions for long-context chat and streaming workloads when using FlashAttentionV2 with fused QKV->attn paths and rotor/rope-aware kernel selection. This change also integrates KV-cache-friendly batching and continuous batching scheduling hooks so that the runtime can maintain low latency while improving token throughput. Changes include: 1) upstream FlashAttentionV2 integration and build targets (cuda kernels + CMake changes); 2) fused QKV and rop/rotary operator implementations with fallbacks for legacy models; 3) kernel selection heuristics based on sequence length and rotary/rope presence; 4) KV-cache API tweaks to expose append-friendly layouts and tagging for continuous-batching; 5) scheduler updates to enable continuous batching on latency-sensitive routes with configurable max-queue-time and per-model batching profiles. Checklist: - [x] Upstream kernel integration and CI build - [x] Unit tests for fused ops and rope/rotary parity - [x] E2E perf benchmarks in perf-canary lab (latency and throughput) - [x] Backwards-compatible fallbacks to current kernels for models flagged in model-registry - [x] Rollout plan with canary and percentage-based ramp. Compatibility notes: default behavior is unchanged unless model profile enables FlashAttentionV2; fallback path remains for unsupported hardware (CUDA < 11.8 or older GPUs). For private deployments, installer package now exposes an opt-in flag in redwood-private-installer to enable the new kernels. Performance summary (perf-canary runs vs baseline using 32k context, GPT-like model): - Median p50 token latency: -18% - p95 latency: -12% - Tokens/sec throughput (sustained): +34% - GPU utilization (inference stage): +22% Sanity and safety: validated numerical parity on a 200-sample prompt set (logits and top-5 tokens matched within 1e-4 on FP32; quantized paths tested for functional parity with tolerances). Rollout: deploy to canary pool (5% traffic) for 48h, then 25% for 24-48h and full ramp; automatic rollback on error-rate regressions (>2x baseline) or latency SLO violations. See release_notes for more detail.

release_notes: Upgrade: Attention kernels -> FlashAttentionV2 with fused QKV ops and rope/rotary support. Performance: up to ~34% throughput improvement on long-context workloads; lower token latency. Opt-in via model profile; automatic fallback on unsupported hardware. See rollout plan and perf-canary results.
rollout_plan: Canary 5% (48h) -> 25% (24-48h) -> 100% with automatic rollback on error-rate or latency SLO regressions.
testing_summary: Unit and integration tests added; numerical parity validated on 200-sample prompt set (FP32 tolerance 1e-4). Perf-canarybenchmarks include short/long-context and streaming cases; p50/p95/p99 tracked.
notes_for_ops: Ops: ensure CUDA toolkit >= 11.8 for new kernels; installer exposes opt-in flag `enable_flashattnv2=true`. If private install must remain on older CUDA, set flag to false to retain previous kernels.
